targets.old_statement: A school bus warns that it is about to stop with yellow and red lights that flash in turn, and the yellow lights come on 100 feet ahead of the stop in zones of 35 mph or less but 300 feet ahead in faster zones.
targets.old_spoken_statement: A school bus warns that it is about to stop with yellow and red lights that flash in turn, and the yellow lights come on one hundred feet ahead of the stop in zones of thirty-five miles per hour or less but three hundred feet ahead in faster zones.
targets.statement: School buses flash yellow and red lights alternately when stopping for students, activating flashing yellow lights at least one hundred feet ahead in speed zones of thirty-five miles per hour or less and at least three hundred feet ahead in faster zones.

targets.old_statement: A driver who passes a stopped school bus faces a misdemeanor, while the vehicle's owner or lessee faces a petty misdemeanor unless they show someone else was driving.
